row.notes: Renamed from Game_CarCustomisation_ApplyPlayerLiveryAndDecals: both callers pass the object they fetched with k_Career_CareerSponsorsComponentDesc, so this is a sponsors-component method. Scans the entries at +0x298..+0x2a0 (stride 0x88) for one whose key matches a game-mode entrant (mode+0x2e0, stride 0x88) with flag 0x10000000 at +0x48 and takes its first sub-item (stride 0x160) with +0xd8==0 and +0x158!=0, else falls back to the +0x500 list entry whose id +0x28 equals the MyTeam setup global 0x14606f43c. For that item it resolves the vehicle customisation key (0x141401e00 on +0x380); if the customisation sponsor id +0x78 differs from item+0xdc it calls 0x141107e60(this, item), else it re-adds the flagged decals (+0xe8 list) with 0x14144aa50; then Game_FrontendSceneComponentCar_SetCarDecals, Career_MyTeam_ApplyLiveryDriverCustomisations, Career_OwnerSetup_ApplySuit and driver UpdateDecals. Game_CarCustomisation_ApplyAllCustomisation calls it in customisation context 2/3 after replacing the vehicle customisation; caller 0x1420589d0 calls it after assigning g_FeTile_AssignedVehicleCustomisationKey.
